Welcome!
<br>
<br>
I am a Ph.D. Candidate (ABD) studying Political Science and International Affairs at the University of Georgia. My major field is International Relations, while my minor field is Political Methodology.
<br>
<br>
Prior to enrolling at the University of Georgia, I earned my Master of Arts in Political Science with an Emphasis in International Relations and Comparative Politics from San Diego State University in May 2018. Before that, I earned my Bachelor of Arts in International Security and Conflict Resolution with a Concentration in Cooperation, Conflict, and Conflict Resolution from San Diego State University in May 2014. Additionally, I minored in Islamic and Arabic Studies.
<br>
<br>
My research is primarily centered around human rights and human security issues, with particular interest in the relationship between democracy and violations of physical integrity rights, public opinion and foreign policy regarding the protection of others' human rights and the prevention of abuses, and violence against civilian populations.
